January 1, 2025

# Support `Delayed` Fulfillment Status in GraphQL API

DateJanuary 1, 2025

Version[2025-01](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_version=2025-01)

FlagsUpdate

SurfacesAPI

Affected APIs[GraphQL Admin API](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_type=admin-graphql)

As of Admin API 2025-01, we have officially introduced a new [fulfillment event status](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2024-10/enums/FulfillmentEventStatus) called `delayed`.
